RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 15

Panel composition alone proves nothing. All-female panels are common in many ministries simply because of who holds senior posts there, and there's no evidence that same-sex panels favour their own sex in any reliable direction. Raising it would read as an accusation resting on nothing, and it would discredit the one complaint you actually have grounds for.

That complaint is real: you asked for written reasons two weeks ago and got silence. Chase it in writing, cite the relevant transparency or recruitment rules, and set a deadline. Ask specifically how the criteria were scored.

If the reasons eventually reveal a criterion invented after the fact, or scoring that doesn't match the stated requirements, that's your case. Judge the decision, not the faces.
